packageRules.description: Group all dependency updates in docs/examples into a single PR
Bump the Checker Framework version in the examples as soon as a release reaches Maven Central, in its own PR. Must come after the docs/examples grouping rule so it wins.
Do not delay JDK EA builds to avoid downloading superseded/deleted binaries
Do not delay security vulnerability fixes

schedule: before 3am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Never update com.google.errorprone:javac; Renovate proposes 9-dev-r4023-3 as an update to our pinned 9+181-r4173-1, but that is not a version we want.

Make the JDK EA build-bump PR title (from the JDK_EA_BUILD custom manager below) show the full jdk-<major>+<build> tag: the default title would otherwise show only the bare build number (e.g. 'to v17'), which reads as a JDK major-version bump instead of an EA build bump. commitMessageTopic/commitMessageExtra must live in a packageRule, not on the custom manager itself. depTypeTemplate in the custom manager exposes the captured major version as {{{depType}}} for this template.

customManagers.description: Update the Checker Framework version in the docs/examples Gradle builds. Renovate's Gradle manager is not relied on here: these builds hold the version in a variable (an `ext.versions` map entry, or a plain `def`), and the only Renovate edits ever seen in these files were plugin versions.
